description: Five transposers for pitch voltages, two working in octaves, two in semitones and one in fractions of a semitone

params.text: Shifts the pitch in whole octaves, four down to four up
Shifts the pitch in whole semitones, six down to six up
Shifts the pitch by a fraction of a semitone, a semitone down to a semitone up, without stepping

inputs.text: The pitch voltage the octave section transposes
The pitch voltage the semitone section transposes
Every 2V here shifts the pitch a whole octave, rounded to the nearest octave and added to the knob; this jack drives both octave sections
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the octave CV jack of the first octave section shifts both of them
Every 2V here shifts the pitch a whole semitone, rounded to the nearest semitone and added to the knob
The pitch voltage the fine section transposes
A quarter of the voltage here is added to the pitch, so 4V shifts it a whole octave

outputs.text: The pitch from the octave input, shifted by the knob and by the octave CV
The pitch from the semitone input, shifted by the knob and by the semitone CV
The pitch from the fine input, shifted by the knob and by the fine CV

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

inputs.3: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
